description: Terraform describes desired infrastructure in configuration files. We will use a built-in local example to learn variables, plans, state and careful review without creating cloud resources. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.

seo.title: Terraform Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Terraform with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
